name: Basketball Trivia
description: Hoops history, rules, nicknames and legendary nights on the hardwood.
question: {prompt}

cards.prompt: Who invented basketball in 1891?
cards.fact: Naismith created the game in Springfield, Massachusetts, as an indoor winter activity.

cards.prompt: What did the very first basketball games use as hoops?
cards.fact: Someone had to fetch the ball after every basket until open-bottomed nets came along.

cards.prompt: How high is a regulation basketball rim above the floor?
cards.fact: The height has been 10 feet since Naismith nailed the first baskets to a balcony rail.

cards.prompt: How many players does each team have on the court at once?
cards.fact: Early games sometimes had nine players a side before five became standard.

cards.prompt: How many points is a field goal made from inside the three-point line worth?
cards.fact: A free throw is worth one point, and a shot from beyond the arc is worth three.

cards.prompt: How long is a quarter in an NBA game?
cards.fact: International (FIBA) and WNBA games use 10-minute quarters.

cards.prompt: How many seconds is the NBA shot clock?
cards.fact: The shot clock arrived in 1954 to stop teams stalling with a lead.

cards.prompt: How far is the NBA three-point line from the basket at the top of the arc?
cards.fact: It shortens to 22 feet in the corners.

cards.prompt: How many personal fouls does it take to foul out of an NBA game?
cards.fact: College and international players foul out after five.

cards.prompt: Taking too many steps while holding the ball without dribbling is called what?
cards.fact: The penalty is losing possession to the other team.

cards.prompt: Blocking a shot after it has started coming down toward the basket is what violation?
cards.fact: The rule was introduced in the 1940s partly because of tall centers like George Mikan.

cards.prompt: Reaching double figures in three stat categories in one game is called what?
cards.fact: The usual three are points, rebounds and assists.

cards.prompt: A pass lobbed near the rim that a teammate catches in mid-air and slams home is called what?
cards.fact: The name comes from the French "allez hop!", a circus cry before a jump.

cards.prompt: What format is the NBA Finals series?
cards.fact: The first team to win four games takes the championship.

cards.prompt: What is the nickname of the NCAA college basketball tournament each spring?
cards.fact: The men’s tournament has used a 64-team bracket since 1985, plus play-in games since 2001.

cards.prompt: Who scored 100 points in a single NBA game in 1962?
cards.fact: The game was played in Hershey, Pennsylvania, and wasn’t televised.

cards.prompt: Who scored 81 points against the Toronto Raptors in 2006?
cards.fact: It is the second-highest single-game total in NBA history, behind Wilt’s 100.

cards.prompt: How many NBA championships did Michael Jordan win with the Chicago Bulls?
cards.fact: Jordan won two "three-peats": 1991–93 and 1996–98, and was Finals MVP every time.

cards.prompt: Which Boston Celtics center won a record 11 NBA championships as a player?
cards.fact: Russell won his 11 titles in 13 seasons, the last two as player-coach.

cards.prompt: Which player’s signature shot was the "skyhook"?
cards.fact: Kareem was known as Lew Alcindor when he starred at UCLA.

cards.prompt: Who passed Kareem Abdul-Jabbar in 2023 to become the NBA’s all-time leading scorer?
cards.fact: Kareem had held the record since 1984.

cards.prompt: Larry Bird spent his entire NBA career with which team?
cards.fact: Bird’s 1980s rivalry with Magic Johnson’s Lakers revived the league’s popularity.

cards.prompt: Magic Johnson spent his entire NBA career with which team?
cards.fact: As a rookie, Magic started at center in the 1980 Finals clincher and was named Finals MVP.

cards.prompt: Which team drafted Kobe Bryant in 1996 before trading him to the Lakers?
cards.fact: Kobe went straight from high school and was picked 13th overall.

cards.prompt: Stephen Curry won NBA titles in 2015, 2017, 2018 and 2022 with which team?
cards.fact: Curry’s long-range shooting helped turn the three-pointer into the league’s main weapon.

cards.prompt: Dennis Rodman led the NBA in which statistic for seven straight seasons (1992–98)?
cards.fact: Rodman did it while standing a modest 6 feet 7 inches.

cards.prompt: Which high-flying star was known as "Dr. J"?
cards.fact: Erving made the free-throw-line slam dunk famous in the 1976 ABA dunk contest.

cards.prompt: Whose silhouette is widely said to be the model for the NBA logo?
cards.fact: The logo was designed in 1969; the league has never officially confirmed the model.

cards.prompt: The NBA Finals MVP trophy is named after which legend?
cards.fact: It was renamed in 2009; the championship trophy itself is the Larry O’Brien Trophy.

cards.prompt: What was the nickname of the 1992 US Olympic men’s basketball team?
cards.fact: It was the first US Olympic team with NBA players, and won every game by at least 32 points.

cards.prompt: Which exhibition team is famous for its "Sweet Georgia Brown" warm-up routine?
cards.fact: Despite the name, the Globetrotters were founded in Chicago in the 1920s.

cards.prompt: Which is the only NBA team based in Canada?
cards.fact: The Raptors won their first title in 2019; the Grizzlies left Vancouver for Memphis in 2001.

cards.prompt: Which US women’s professional basketball league was founded in 1996 with the backing of the NBA?
cards.fact: The WNBA played its first season in 1997.
